title: fix(enter): move the event code input to the bottom of the quests page
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Moved the Event code section from below the summary to the bottom of the Quests page. Links with a `?code=` parameter now scroll the prefilled input into view and focus it after quests load, so the scroll targets the section's final position.

image.prompt: On a cozy pixel art Quests page, Polli points to a lime green (#ecf874) event-code input at the bottom of a scrollable list, beside a small flower pot. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene and wears tiny reading glasses. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
